test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the 3 conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

Some teas are coffees.

All coffees are waters.

All teas are colas.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some colas are waters.

II. Some coffees are colas.

III. Some waters are teas.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow

solution:
Statements:

Some teas are coffees.

All coffees are waters.

All teas are colas.
